## What's new
- Works on all OXID eShop 7 versions (7.0 and later), not only 7.5.
- Requires PHP 8.1 or later (was 8.3).
- Requires the Twig admin theme. OXID eShop 6.x and older are not supported.

No functional changes since v1.0.1.

## Installation
```sh
composer require stathubs/oxid
vendor/bin/oe-console oe:module:activate solu1stathubs
```
Then open **Extensions → StatHubs** in the admin and scan the QR code with the StatHubs app.

Without Composer: download `stathubs-oxid.zip` below and follow the [README](../../blob/v1.1.0/README.md#without-composer-zip).
